reason: The two files accepted as distinct desktop DPR1 and DPR2 captures in R80 are byte-identical and do not prove two deviceScaleFactor configurations.
finding: Both artifacts have identical encoded bytes, dimensions, and SHA-256. The matrix contains authored deviceScaleFactor values but no capture-time window.devicePixelRatio trace. The shared 1490x755 raster dimensions also do not independently establish either claimed viewport/DPR configuration.
acceptedEvidenceRetained: R79 mobile DPR1/DPR2/DPR3 and tablet DPR1/DPR2 visual captures
requiredEvidence: Two independently generated desktop artifacts, one at DPR1 and one at DPR2
Capture-time window.devicePixelRatio recorded in the same auditable trace as each screenshot
Viewport dimensions, currentSrc/resource byte data, and screenshot hash for each run
Visual confirmation that all six images decode/render without blank cards, letterboxing, or distortion
